detail.longDescription:
Jenson is volunteering along with the Mastodon crew surely with the expectation that millions of people are going to interact with the software...and yet he's terrible with people! He wants to behave here like as though he were a private citizen, free to block anyone on impulse or whatever. 

I don't have an answer to this conundrum; I merely point it out, and I daresay this is a widespread problem. There's a great many people out there in the #programming world who work on stuff *expecting* that it will have a huge userbase, while disclaiming all responsibility to the community which arises inevitably out of that collective userbase. The programmers want to stick to their "libertarian" model of the world in which they can hide from others if they want and refuse to answer questions about their job if they want and so forth.
